text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: And now, the moment we've all been<n>waiting for.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Our Umamusume of the Year! She's<n>the brightest
star of the Twinkle<n>Series...

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
With countless triumphs over her<n>formidable peers
at the G1 level, her<n>talents truly are befitting of an
empress!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Air Groove, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Beginning with the Shinzan Kinen,<n>Taiki Shuttle has
faced every battle<n>head-on.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her achievements are recognized by<n>the
association, and she is presented<n>the award for
best sprinter.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
However, the road to becoming<n>Umamusume of the
Year turns out to<n>be far more arduous than we
anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps we should have entered<n>more races. Or
branched out beyond<n>mile races.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We gave it our utmost effort... and yet<n>I can't stop
thinking about what else<n>we could have done.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did ya see what happened at the<n>press
conference?! Air Groove is—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume of the Year, right? Of<n>course I saw!
She really is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Right?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But ya know, this year's lineup was<n>pretty
strong—it could've easily gone<n>to someone else.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's true. There was Grass<n>Wonder in the junior
division, and<n>Mejiro Dober in the classic division...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention Taiki Shuttle in the<n>sprint division.
Everyone was a<n>powerhouse in their own right.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But... power alone doesn't win you<n>the title of
Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove was just on another level!<n>She tore up
the track like nobody's<n>business!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
She snatched everybody's hearts<n>right outta their
chests to claim the<n>win! So cool...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's the perfect title for someone like<n>me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What the heck are you talking<n>about?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The year's number one Umamusume,<n>who's
number one in everyone's<n>hearts... No one else fits
the bill but<n>me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, them's fightin' words! Why<n>don't we settle
this on the track?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The top Umamusume in everyone's<n>hearts...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It won't be easy to leave a lasting<n>impression
through sprint and mile<n>races alone.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I return to the track, mulling over<n>those concerns...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's get runnin', Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I wondered who was trying to bowl<n>me over... I
should have known it was<n>you, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course—I'll be your opponent.<n>Let's have a good
run.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, Fukukitaru! Let's go<n>running—you and me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Taiki?! What's this all of a sudden?! I<n>was only
passing by!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Then this must be destiny! Talk about<n>lucky! Now,
let's go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But I have to follow Shiraoki's divine<n>message!
"Take it easy this<n>afternoon for good fortu"—wait!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Worked up a good sweat!<n>Now, who should
my next target be...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, I'm outta time! We got<n>ourselves some
training to do, don't<n>we?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle is just as energetic—no,more energetic than usual.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But hard work and a positive mindset<n>alone won't
get her any closer to<n>becoming Umamusume of the
Year...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Listen up!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Can ya do me a favor, please?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I want ya to put me in as many G1<n>sprints and
miles as ya can rustle up.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'll be number one in all of<n>'em—promise!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I ran all those sprints and miles ya<n>recommended
last year, right?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And how was I?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wasn't it exciting? Wasn't I<n>fantastic?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Bet your boots I was! If ya ask me, I<n>think I'm
plenty exciting and fantastic<n>right now too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm gonna win. When it<n>comes to
speed, there ain't no way I<n>can lose!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll get even stronger and faster!<n>More and more
and more!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Til I reach everybody's hearts!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Life is what ya make it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep pushin' forward and<n>carve out my
own path, even if I'm<n>the only one to walk it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And I'll do it with these trusty legs of<n>mine—the
ones you never stopped<n>believing in!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: That's right...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who told her that her<n>power and speed
were unparalleled<n>in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And yet...
choice_data_list: (What good am I if I can't trust her?)
(What good am I if I can't trust her?)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So whaddya think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Do ya still believe in me?
choice_data_list:
I believe you'll be the next Umamusume of the
Year!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeehaaaw! That's what I like to hear!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer! It's definitely<n>happening next
year...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll make my dream come true! I'm<n>gonna be
Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
First things first—we're taking on the<n>Yasuda Kinen,
the race that crowns<n>the spring King of the Mile!
